question: Identify the constructor with the highest total points among those that have at least one driver who recorded a fastest lap time within the top 10 ranks in any race held in Spain between 2005 and 2010. Return the constructor's name and nationality.

prediction.sql:
WITH qualifying_constructors AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT r.XCL_076 AS constructor_id
  FROM results r
  INNER JOIN races ra ON r.XCL_074 = ra.XCL_065
  INNER JOIN circuits c ON ra.XCL_068 = c.XCL_001
  WHERE c.XCL_005 = 'Spain'
    AND ra.XCL_066 BETWEEN 2005 AND 2010
    AND r.XCL_087 <= 10
)
SELECT ct.XCL_024, ct.XCL_025
FROM constructorResults cr
INNER JOIN constructors ct ON cr.XCL_012 = ct.XCL_022
INNER JOIN qualifying_constructors qc ON ct.XCL_022 = qc.constructor_id
GROUP BY ct.XCL_022
ORDER BY SUM(cr.XCL_013) DESC
LIMIT 1

roles.description: Lap time recorded in the first qualifying session (Q1). This is the most frequently populated time column, serving as the baseline for all qualifying entries.

Participation in the third qualifying session (Q3) implies participation in the second qualifying session (Q2). The data confirms this: every row with a Q3 time has a Q2 time, but many rows with a Q2 time do not have a Q3 time.
